limitations: Only known subscription codecs are supported; new catalog slugs do not imply unknown protocol or modality support.
Full pool requires the matched authenticated server lifecycle hook; a fixed endpoint alone does not prove native GUI credential delivery.
Assistant Chat Completions, direct PDF/audio/video, hosted provider tools, image editing, queue/multiworker and purchasing are unsupported.
Live device consent, rotating renewal, multiple real accounts, image generation, reset spending, cache savings and model-quality equivalence are unqualified for this release.
Encrypted local continuity defaults to 30 days idle / 90 days absolute; store:false does not retain prompt or response bodies.
Legacy native workflow crash replay is unsupported; native unknown/duplicate outcomes fail closed.
Stock standalone Agents has no user fork/regenerate endpoint in this pinned runtime; the integration does not add one.
Synthetic episodic memory uses a separately configured embedding backend; Codex Wire embeddings remain unsupported.

Agents source differential retains the six known baseline diagnostics. Expanded lifecycle/security source and dependency differentials are recorded separately; no full upstream clean typecheck is claimed.
Pinned Agent V3 Code Tool may add call metadata such as toolCallId; a strict manual schema can reject those additional fields. Check tool results and declare the intended schema explicitly.
Stock Simple Memory retains restored tool-group metadata but constructs final assistant messages from visible strings without provider metadata; missing final opaque reasoning is not reconstructed.
Stock Simple Memory is process-local. Saved Chat history does not guarantee provider context after a process restart.
Pinned stock Zod-based parsers are unqualified for untrusted model output. Use the optional Codex Output Parser in an ordinary Agent or Basic LLM Chain.

The basic private Codex Chat route admits at most262144 UTF-16 visible text units,1024 ASCII quotes and67108864 cumulative rendering-work units; unsafe fragments cause controlled refusal without truncation.
